name: openoutreach_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the openoutreach capability.

prompts.name: lead_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Find leads for a product described as: {product_description} targeting: {target_market}.
prompts.use_case: Startup companies seeking targeted leads for their new product launch.

prompts.name: email_creation_prompt
prompts.template: Create a personalized outreach email for a product: {product_description} to a target: {target_market}.
prompts.use_case: Sales teams automating initial outreach to potential clients.
